'''Akaka:''' {{legend0|#7996e2|50–60%}} {{legend0|#6674de|60–70%}} | title = U.S. Senator | before_election = [[Daniel Akaka]] | before_party = Democratic Party (United States) | after_election = [[Daniel Akaka]] | after_party = Democratic Party (United States) }} {{Elections in Hawaii}} The '''1990 United States Senate special election in Hawaii''' took place on November 4, 1990. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator [[Daniel Akaka]] was elected to finish the term ending in 1995. He had been appointed by Governor [[John Waihee|John Waiheʻe]] in April 1990 to serve temporarily after the death of [[Spark Matsunaga]].{{Cite web|url=http://www.ourcampaigns.com/RaceDetail.html?RaceID=2520|title = Our Campaigns - HI US Senate - Special Election Race - Nov 06, 1990}} This was the best Republican performance in a U.S. Senate race in Hawaii where the Democrat won since [[Hiram Fong]] retired in [[1976 United States Senate election in Hawaii|1976]].{{Cite web|url=https://www.senate.gov/states/HI/intro.htm|title=U.S. Senate:
